name: nuSCOPE
full_name: Monitored and tagged short-baseline neutrino experiment at CERN
summary: nuSCOPE is a proposed CERN precision-neutrino facility combining the ENUBET monitored-beam concept with NuTag event tagging. It aims to control both flux and incident-neutrino energy for cross-section measurements.
physics_targets: Precision electron- and muon-neutrino cross sections
Nuclear effects relevant to DUNE and Hyper-Kamiokande
Short-baseline oscillation and other new-physics sensitivity
detection_principle: Instrumented decay regions identify charged leptons accompanying neutrino production, while fast beamline tracking associates selected parent decays with neutrino interactions. Monitoring constrains flux and tagging provides an energy estimate independent of nuclear final-state reconstruction.
